Subject: Elsmere Office Partners - Quote in Progress

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the submission on Elsmere Office Partners! I've received the application, statement of values, and loss runs—everything looks complete.

I'm working on putting together a competitive quote for the January 10, 2027 effective date. Given the $25.4M total insured value across the three locations, I'll need a day or two to review the loss history and finalize terms.

I'll reach out if any questions come up, but expect a proposal from me shortly.

Thanks for thinking of us!

Best regards,  
[Underwriter name]
